subject: general
question: G20 Foreign Ministers meeting 2022 was held in which of the following countries?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Indonesia**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The first G20 Foreign Ministers' Meeting of 2022 was held in** Bali, Indonesia **on **July 7-8, 2022**.
 
• The meeting was chaired by Indonesian Foreign Minister** Retno Marsudi**.
 
• The main topics of discussion at the meeting were the **global economic recovery, the COVID-19 pandemic, **and** the situation in Ukraine**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e085a7f17645c801966c030eb44d69fae944b96fdb4c4077f5fba1bc2c24bc71.png] **Mistake Points__**

__
 
• The G20 Foreign Ministers' Meeting of 2023 was held in New Delhi, India on **March 1-2, 2023**.
 
• The meeting was chaired by Indian Foreign Minister **S. Jaishankar**. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **G20**

 
 
• The G20, or Group of Twenty, is an intergovernmental forum comprising** 19 countries** and the **European Union (EU)**.
 
• The G20 was established in** 1999** in response to the financial crises that arose in a number of emerging economies in the 1990s.
 
• The forum was created to provide a forum for dialogue and cooperation between the world's major economies on key economic issues.
 
• **The G20 is made up of the following countries:**
 
 
• Argentina
 
• Australia
 
• Brazil
 
• Canada
 
• China
 
• France
 
• Germany
 
• India
 
• Indonesia
 
• Italy
 
• Japan
 
• Mexico
 
• Russia
 
• Saudi Arabia
 
• South Africa
 
• South Korea
 
• Turkey
 
• United Kingdom
 
• United States
 
• European Union
